column1: # Format: <group><TAB><repo-relative path prefix>, one prefix per line; a group
# may list several prefixes. Matching (see tests/affected.sh): per changed path
# the LONGEST matching prefix wins, groups tying at the winning length all
# fire; matches print deduped in this file's order. A path matching no prefix
# maps to `all`. Diff = git diff --name-only <ref> (ref vs working tree).
